name: eBay Inc. v. MercExchange, L.L.C.
summary: The Supreme Court held that courts must apply a traditional four-factor equitable test before issuing a permanent injunction, rejecting the idea that injunctions should automatically follow a finding of liability.
significance: Cited for the standards governing issuance of permanent injunctions in federal courts, including the requirement that injunctive relief be appropriately tailored to the harm found.
